Global warming levels and crossing times
15-year quadratic endpoint fit · corrected retrospective 2011–2025 outputs
It is very unlikely that warming exceeds 1.5°C
Dark blue: definitive crossing + centered 10-year rate
Red: 15 years before selected method’s predicted crossing
Red 2025 line: selected-method level and fitted recent rate
Global warming levels and exceedance probabilities
1.0°C benchmark: 93 observed + 7 quartic estimates; model uncertainty excluded
